coverage_override.reason: The negate Quick Effect, sent-to-GY recovery trigger, and shared each-effect HOPT are three audit units.

effects.printed_clause: When the opponent activates a monster effect: send 1 Skewy! card from your hand or field to the GY; return this card to hand, and if you do, negate that activation.
effects.lua_implementation: An opponent-monster EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect now excludes its handler from the eligible hand/field Skewy cost group. Resolution returns the still-related handler to hand and negates only after that return succeeds.

official_references.matched_structure: Pays with another archetype card while preserving the handler for a return-to-hand operation.
Returns a card to hand and conditionally negates an activation.

effects.issue: Fixed: Boo-Boo can no longer be selected as its own send-to-GY cost, which made the mandatory return-and-negate sequence impossible.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to the GY: add 1 Skewy! monster from your GY to your hand, except Skewy! Boo-Boo.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE trigger selects another archetype Monster from the GY under Necrovalley, adds it, and reveals it.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a sent/field trigger to recover a filtered archetype card from the GY.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Skewy! Boo-Boo once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The negate and recovery effects use distinct id and id+100 hard count keys.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses id-keyed once-per-turn handling on a negation effect.
